findings.label: Read-only role still carries index-write grants
findings.detail: cloudformation/xamops-readonly-role.yml keeps resource-explorer-2:CreateIndex/UpdateIndexType in the policy (pre-existing, unchanged by this diff). They are now inert because the application flag xamops.inventory.auto-create-indexes defaults to false, but the role is not literally read-only. Acceptable as documented (eases promotion to the read-write integration without a policy edit). If strict least-privilege on the read-only role is desired, remove the two grants in a follow-up.
